akhfash:36-36.t:
[He said:] ﴿وَلاَ تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْبَصَرَ وَٱلْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُولـٰئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْؤُولاً﴾. He said ﴿أُولـٰئِكَ﴾: for this and its like, whether masculine or feminine, you say "أُولَئِكَ". The poet said [in the kāmil metre; this is poetic witness no. 71]:
ذُمِّي المنازِلَ بَعْدَ مَنْزِلَةِ اللِّوىَ * وَالْعَيْشَ بَعْدَ أُولئِكِ الأَيامِ
(Blame the dwellings after the dwelling at al-Liwā, and life after those days.)
And this is frequent.

akhfash:37-37.t: And one says ﴿مَرَحاً﴾ and ﴿مَرِحا﴾; the one with kasra is the better of the two, because if you said "تَمِشي مَرِحا" (she walks exultant) it would be better than "تَمْشى مَرَحا" (she walks in exultation). But we read it with fatḥa.

akhfash:43-43.t:
And He said ﴿سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ عُلُوّاً كَبِيراً﴾: He said ﴿عُلُوّاً﴾ and did not say "تَعالِياً" (the maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb's own form), just as He said ﴿وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلاً﴾. The poet said [in the kāmil metre; this is poetic witness no. 241]:
أَنْتَ الفِداءُ لِكَعْبَةٍ هَدَّمْتَها * وَنَقَرْتَها بِيَدَيْكَ كُلَّ مُنَقَّر
مَنَعَ الحَمامَ مَقِيلَهُ من سَقْفِها * ومِنَ الحَطِيمِ فَطَارَ كُلَّ مُطَيَّرِ
(May you be the ransom for a Kaʿba that you demolished and pecked at with your hands with every pecking; you denied the doves their resting place on its roof and on the Ḥaṭīm, so they flew off in every flight.)
Another said [in the rajaz metre; this is poetic witness no. 242]:
* يَجْرِي عَلَيْها أَيَّما إِجْراءِ *
(It runs over it with what a running!)
Another said [in the wāfir metre; this is poetic witness no. 243]:
وَخَيْرُ الأمْرِ ما اسْتَقْبَلْتَ مِنْهُ * وَلَيْسَ بِأَنْ تَتَبَّعَه اتِّباعَا
(The best of an affair is what you meet head-on, not that you follow it up afterwards.)

akhfash:45-45.t: And He said ﴿حِجَاباً مَّسْتُوراً﴾ because the agent may come in the form of the patient, as you say: "إِنَّكَ مَشْؤومْ عَلَيْنا" (you are ill-omened for us) and "مَيْمُون" (well-omened), while it is really "شائِم" (bringing ill omen) and "يامِن" (bringing good omen), since it is from "شَأَمَهُم" (he brought them ill fortune) and "يَمَنَهم" (he brought them good fortune). "الحِجابُ" here is the one that conceals, yet He said ﴿مَسْتُورا﴾ (concealed).

akhfash:47-47.t: And He said ﴿وَإِذْ هُمْ نَجْوَىٰ﴾, while "النَّجْوَى" (secret converse) is really their act, just as you say: "هُمْ قَوْمٌ رِضىً" (they are a people of approval), while "الرِّضَى" (approval) is really their act.

akhfash:53-53.t: And He said ﴿وَقُل لِّعِبَادِي يَقُولُواْ ٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ﴾: He made it (﴿يَقُولُواْ﴾) an answer to the imperative.

akhfash:59-59.t: And He said ﴿وَآتَيْنَا ثَمُودَ ٱلنَّاقَةَ مُبْصِرَةً فَظَلَمُواْ بِهَا﴾: He means "it was through it that their wrongdoing was". And "المُبْصِرَةُ" is the clear sign, just as you say "المُوضِحَة" (the one making plain) and "المُبَيِّنَةُ" (the one making clear).

akhfash:64-64.t: And He said ﴿وَأَجْلِبْ عَلَيْهِم﴾: His word ﴿وَأَجْلِبْ﴾ is from "أَجْلَبْتَ", and it has the meaning of "جَلَبَ"; the form with the connective hamza is from "جَلَبَ" "يَجْلُبُ".

akhfash:77-77.t: And He said ﴿سُنَّةَ مَن قَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ﴾, i.e. "We have established it as a practice (سَنَنّاها سُنَّةَ)", just as He said ﴿رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ﴾.

akhfash:78-78.t: [He said:] ﴿وَقُرْآنَ ٱلْفَجْرِ﴾, i.e. "and incumbent upon you is the recitation of the dawn".

akhfash:79-79.t: And He said ﴿عَسَىٰ أَن يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ﴾ and ﴿عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ﴾. It is said that "عَسَى" (perhaps), when from Allah, is binding. The meaning is that if you knew of a man that he never leaves aside something that is better than something he does, and he said to you "عسى أنْ أُكَافِئَكَ" (perhaps I will reward you), you would infer from your knowledge of him that he will do what is due, since he never leaves aside something that is better than something he does.

akhfash:83-83.t: And He said ﴿يَئُوساً﴾ because it is from "يَئِس" (to despair).

akhfash:110-110.t:
And He said ﴿أَيّاً مَّا تَدْعُواْ﴾, as though He said "أَيَّا تَدْعُوا" (whichever you call upon).
And He said ﴿أَيّاً مَّا تَدْعُواْ فَلَهُ ٱلأَسْمَآءَ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ﴾: He means "whichever of the two invocations you make, to Him belong the most beautiful names".

akhfash:1-1.t:
He said: ﴿سُبْحَانَ ٱلَّذِي أَسْرَىٰ﴾, because you say "أَسْرَيْتُ" and "سَرَيْتُ" (I travelled by night).
And He said ﴿إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلبَصِيرُ﴾: according to what they mentioned — and Allah knows best — it means: "Say, O Muḥammad: Glory be to Him who took His servant by night", and say: "He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing".

akhfash:5-5.t: He said: ﴿فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ أُولاهُمَا﴾, because "الأُوْلى" is like "الكُبْرى": it is used with alif and lām, and one does not say "هذهِ أُوْلى". Annexation alternates with the alif and lām; that is why He said ﴿أُولاهُما﴾, as you say "هذهِ كُبْراهُمٌا" (this is the greater of the two), "كُبْراهُنَّ" and "كُبْرَاهُمْ عِنْدَه".

akhfash:11-11.t: He said: ﴿دُعَاءَهُ بِٱلْخَيْرِ﴾: he put "الدعاءَ" in the accusative by the verb [as a mafʿūl muṭlaq, absolute object], as you say: "إِنَّكَ مُنْطَلِقٌ انْطِلاقاً" (you are departing a departure).

akhfash:23-23.t:
He said: ﴿فَلاَ تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّ﴾. It has been read ﴿أُفِّ﴾, and ﴿أُفّاً﴾ — a dialect form which they made like ﴿تَعْساً﴾. Some read ﴿أُفَّ﴾; that is because some Arabs say "أُفَّ لَكَ" by way of quotation (ḥikāya), i.e. do not say this word to them. The nominative is ugly because it does not come followed by the lām. Those who read ﴿أُفِّ﴾ with kasra are many, and it is the best. Some gave it kasra with tanwīn. Some read ﴿أُفِّي﴾, as though he annexed this word to himself and said "أُفّي هذا لكما" (this "uff" of mine to you two). The kasra form here is with tanwīn, and without tanwīn on the basis that it is a fully declinable noun [Translator's note: the comparison with «أَمْسِ» suggests indeclinable (mabnī) is meant; translated as written.] like "أَمْسِ" (yesterday) and the like; and the fatḥa form without tanwīn likewise.
And He said ﴿وَلاَ تَنْهَرْهُمَا﴾, because one says "نَهَرَه" "يَنْهَرَه" and "اِنْتَهَرُه" "يَنْتَهِرُهُ" (to rebuke).

akhfash:31-31.t:
He said: ﴿إنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ كَانَ خِطْئاً﴾, from "خَطِىء" "يَخْطَأُ", whose explanation is "he sinned"; it is not in the sense of "أَخْطَأَ" (to err), because what you erred [in] is what you did by mistake, while [what] you "خَطِئْتَ" [in] is what you did deliberately, and that is sin. Some Arabs, however, say "خَطِئْتُ" in the sense of "أَخْطَأْتُ". Imruʾ al-Qays said [in the rajaz metre, and it is the two hundred and thirty-ninth poetic witness]:
يا لَهْفَ نَفْسي إِذْ خَطِئْنَ كَاهِلا * القاتِلِينَ المَلِكَ الحُلاحِلا
* تَالله لا يذهبُ شَيْخِي باطِلا *
(Alas for my soul, when they [the horses] missed Kāhil, the slayers of the noble king! By Allah, my old father's blood shall not go unavenged.)
Another said [in the kāmil metre, and it is the two hundred and fortieth poetic witness]:
والناسُ يَلْحُونَ الأَمِيرَ إِذاَ هُمُ * خَطِئُوا الصَّوابَ وَلاَ يُلامُ المُرْشَدُ
(People blame the commander when they themselves miss what is right, yet the one rightly guided is not to blame.)

akhfash:35-35.t: He said: ﴿وَزِنُواْ بِٱلقِسْطَاسِ﴾; "القُسْطاس" is like "القِرْطَاس" and "القُرْطاس" (paper), and "الفِسْطاط" and "الفُسْطاط" (tent) [i.e. both kasra and ḍamma are used].

daas-irab:1-3.t: ﴿سُبْحانَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَسْرى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِعَبْدِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to أسرى, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَيْلًا﴾: an adverb of time attached to أسرى. ﴿مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أسرى. ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of مسجد. ﴿إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أسرى. ﴿الْأَقْصَى﴾: an adjective, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, a second adjective. ﴿بارَكْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿حَوْلَهُ﴾: an adverb of place attached to باركنا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِنُرِيَهُ﴾: the lām is of cause (taʿlīl), and نريه is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of cause; it and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun); the two are attached to the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "ذلك لنريه". ﴿مِنْ آياتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نريه. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿هُوَ السَّمِيعُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar. ﴿الْبَصِيرُ﴾: a second khabar, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَآتَيْنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مُوسَى﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَجَعَلْناهُ هُدىً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِبَنِي﴾: بني is a noun, genitive (majrūr) by the lām, its sign of the genitive being the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural; the two are attached to هدى. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿أَلَّا﴾: an is redundant (zāʾida) or explicative (mufassira), and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَتَّخِذُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā through the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is explicative. ﴿مِنْ دُونِي﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun take the place of the second object of تتخذوا, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكِيلًا﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ذُرِّيَّةَ﴾: badal (substitute) of وكيلا. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَمَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مَعَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to حملنا. ﴿نُوحٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ عَبْداً﴾: kāna and its khabar, and its noun is omitted [Translator's note: i.e. it is a latent pronoun]; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿شَكُوراً﴾: an adjective of عبدا.

daas-irab:4-5.t: ﴿وَقَضَيْنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلى بَنِي﴾: بني is a noun, genitive (majrūr) by إلى through the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural; the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to قضينا. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿فِي الْكِتابِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قضينا. ﴿لَتُفْسِدُنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn [Translator's note: so in the source; the nūn of the indicative is in fact deleted here because of the succession of nūns], and the deleted wāw is the fāʿil, the ḍamma being a sign of it, and the nūn is for emphasis. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تفسدن. ﴿مَرَّتَيْنِ﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is dual; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath. ﴿وَلَتَعْلُنَّ﴾: conjoined to لتفسدن, and its i'rab is like its i'rab. ﴿عُلُوًّا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿كَبِيراً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of علو. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿جاءَ وَعْدُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أُولاهُما﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif because of impossibility, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَعَثْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بعثنا. ﴿عِباداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of عبادا. ﴿أُولِي﴾: a second adjective of عباد. ﴿بَأْسٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شَدِيدٍ﴾: an adjective. ﴿فَجاسُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿خِلالَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to جاسوا. ﴿الدِّيارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكانَ وَعْداً﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and kāna and its khabar (predicate), and its noun is omitted. ﴿مَفْعُولًا﴾: an adjective of وعدا.

daas-irab:6-7.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿رَدَدْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَكُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to رددنا. ﴿الْكَرَّةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رددنا. ﴿وَأَمْدَدْناكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِأَمْوالٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أمددناكم. ﴿وَبَنِينَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to أموال, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿وَجَعَلْناكُمْ أَكْثَرَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and أكثر is its second object. ﴿نَفِيراً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿إِنْ﴾: a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive. ﴿أَحْسَنْتُمْ﴾: the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿أَحْسَنْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is an apodosis not joined to the fāʾ. [Translator's note: so in the source; the apodosis in the verse is the second أحسنتم.] ﴿لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أحسنتم. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and in is conditional. ﴿أَسَأْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil, and the clause is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَلَها﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and لها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "فلها إساءتها"; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis). ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿جاءَ وَعْدُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِيَسُوؤُا﴾: the lām is of cause (taʿlīl); an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of cause, through the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the lām and what follows it are attached to the omitted apodosis of إذا, the implied form being "بعثناهم ليسوؤوا". ﴿وُجُوهَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلِيَدْخُلُوا﴾: conjoined to ليسوؤوا, and its i'rab is like its i'rab. ﴿الْمَسْجِدَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a particle of comparison, and mā is maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar). ﴿دَخَلُوهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the kāf and what follows it are an interpreted maṣdar in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "دخولا كائنا مثل دخولهم". ﴿أَوَّلَ﴾: an adverb of time, accusative. ﴿مَرَّةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلِيُتَبِّرُوا﴾: conjoined to ليدخلوا, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلَوْا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿تَتْبِيراً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq.

daas-irab:8-10.t: ﴿عَسى﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾: the noun of عسى, nominative (marfūʿ), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَرْحَمَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, and the kāf is its object, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); an and what follows it are the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive, and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿عُدْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; it is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿عُدْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is an apodosis not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to حصيرا. ﴿حَصِيراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿هذَا﴾: the hā is for drawing attention, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the accusative as its noun. ﴿الْقُرْآنَ﴾: badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿لِلَّتِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive, and the two are attached to يهدي. ﴿هِيَ أَقْوَمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَيُبَشِّرُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿أَجْراً﴾: the noun of anna. ﴿كَبِيراً﴾: an adjective of أجرا. ﴿وَأَنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and anna is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, the noun of anna, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤمنون. ﴿أَعْتَدْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of anna. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعتدنا. ﴿عَذاباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَلِيماً﴾: an adjective.

daas-irab:11-13.t: ﴿وَيَدْعُ الْإِنْسانُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw because of heaviness, and الإنسان is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِالشَّرِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to يدعو. ﴿دُعاءَهُ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِالْخَيْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to دعاء. ﴿وَكانَ الْإِنْسانُ عَجُولًا﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالنَّهارَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الليل. ﴿آيَتَيْنِ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is dual. ﴿فَمَحَوْنا آيَةَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا آيَةَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿النَّهارَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُبْصِرَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِتَبْتَغُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of cause, its sign of the accusative being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the lām and what follows it are a preposition and its genitive noun, and these are attached to جعلنا. ﴿فَضْلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تبتغوا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلِتَعْلَمُوا﴾: conjoined to لتبتغوا, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿عَدَدَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi of تعلموا. ﴿السِّنِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿وَالْحِسابَ﴾: conjoined to عدد. ﴿وَكُلَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَصَّلْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is explicative (mufassira) and has no grammatical position. ﴿تَفْصِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿وَكُلَّ إِنسانٍ أَلْزَمْناهُ﴾: conjoined to what preceded, and its i'rab is like its i'rab. ﴿طائِرَهُ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي عُنُقِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ألزمناه, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَنُخْرِجُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is "نحن" (we). ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نخرج. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to نخرج. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كِتاباً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source, although no first object of نخرج is named]. ﴿يَلْقاهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of كتابا. ﴿مَنْشُوراً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:14-16.t: ﴿اقْرَأْ كِتابَكَ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and كتاب is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) by an omitted verb, its implied form being "يقال له اقرأ". ﴿كَفى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿بِنَفْسِكَ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and نفسك is the fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) by a ḍamma whose appearance is prevented by the place being occupied by the vowel of the redundant preposition; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached (mutaʿalliq) to كفى, and likewise the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾. ﴿حَسِيباً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿مَنِ﴾: a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿اهْتَدى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on an implied fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility, and its fāʿil is latent; it is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis). ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and إنما is kāffa and makfūfa (the restraining mā and the restrained particle). ﴿يَهْتَدِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis). ﴿لِنَفْسِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يهتدي, and the conditional clause is the khabar (predicate) of من. ﴿وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَإِنَّما يَضِلُّ عَلَيْها﴾: the clause is conjoined, and its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and lā is negative. ﴿تَزِرُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿وازِرَةٌ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿وِزْرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُخْرى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is negative. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿مُعَذِّبِينَ﴾: the khabar of kāna, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿نَبْعَثَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after حتى, and its fāʿil is latent; the preposition and what follows it, the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to معذبين. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿أَرَدْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿نُهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative, and mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَمَرْنا مُتْرَفِيها﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of إذا. ﴿فَفَسَقُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to فسقوا. ﴿فَحَقَّ عَلَيْهَا الْقَوْلُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to حق; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَدَمَّرْناها﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿تَدْمِيراً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

daas-irab:17-18.t: ﴿وَكَمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; كم is predicative (khabariyya), in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أهلكنا. ﴿أَهْلَكْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ الْقُرُونِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to أهلكنا, and what follows من is a tamyīz (specification) in meaning. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿نُوحٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَكَفى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; كفى is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿بِرَبِّكَ﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and رب is the fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِذُنُوبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خبيرا. ﴿عِبادِهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَبِيراً بَصِيراً﴾: each of them is a tamyīz of كفى. ﴿مَنْ كانَ﴾: من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is omitted. ﴿يُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْعاجِلَةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿عَجَّلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is an apodosis not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عجلنا. ﴿فِيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عجلنا. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لِمَنْ﴾: a relative noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نشاء. ﴿نُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جعلنا. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَصْلاها﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility, and its fāʿil is latent, and the hā is mafʿūl bihi; the clause يصلاها is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿مَذْمُوماً مَدْحُوراً﴾: two ḥāls.

daas-irab:19-20.t:
﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَرادَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْآخِرَةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَسَعى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to سعى. ﴿سَعْيَها﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the clause is conjoined, and the hā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ﴾: the wāw is of the ḥāl (circumstantial), and mubtadaʾ and khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl or parenthetical. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; أولاء is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is for address; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis). ﴿كانَ سَعْيُهُمْ مَشْكُوراً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك; the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من. ﴿كُلًّا﴾: a fronted mafʿūl bihi of نمد. ﴿نُمِدُّ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾: ها is for drawing attention; أولاء is a demonstrative in the position of the accusative as badal (substitute) of كلا. ﴿وَهَؤُلاءِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to هؤلاء. ﴿مِنْ عَطاءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نمد. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is negative. ﴿كانَ عَطاءُ﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿مَحْظُوراً﴾: the khabar of kāna, and the clause is conjoined to what preceded.

daas-irab:21-23.t: ﴿انْظُرْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَضَّلْنا بَعْضَهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to فضلنا. ﴿وَلَلْآخِرَةُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and الآخرة is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَكْبَرُ﴾: khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿دَرَجاتٍ﴾: tamyīz (specification), accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿وَأَكْبَرُ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to أكبر. ﴿تَفْضِيلًا﴾: tamyīz. ﴿لا﴾: prohibitive. ﴿تَجْعَلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَعَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to what precedes. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلهاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آخَرَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَتَقْعُدَ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the fāʾ of causation, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَذْمُوماً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿مَخْذُولًا﴾: ḥāl. ﴿وَقَضى رَبُّكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَلَّا﴾: an puts the verb in the accusative, and lā is negative. ﴿تَعْبُدُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an, its sign of the accusative being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَلَّا﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the verse is إِلَّا]: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿إِيَّاهُ﴾: a pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَبِالْوالِدَيْنِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "أحسنوا بالوالدين". ﴿إِحْساناً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿إِمَّا﴾: the conditional in, and mā is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿يَبْلُغَنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis. ﴿عِنْدَكَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the verb, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْكِبَرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَحَدُهُما﴾: a postponed fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿كِلاهُما﴾: a conjoined noun, accusative by the alif because it is assimilated to the dual [Translator's note: so in the source; as conjoined to the fāʿil أحدهما it is nominative by the alif], and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَقُلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive lā, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis). ﴿لَهُما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تقل. ﴿أُفٍّ﴾: a verbal noun (ism fiʿl) of the imperfect, meaning "أتضجر" (I am vexed). ﴿وَلا تَنْهَرْهُما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive lā, whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَقُلْ لَهُما قَوْلًا كَرِيماً﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قل, قولا is mafʿūl muṭlaq, and كريما is an adjective; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:24-26.t: ﴿وَاخْفِضْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَهُما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to أخفض. ﴿جَناحَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الذُّلِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخفض. ﴿وَقُلْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle; it is accusative (manṣūb) as a vocative, and the omitted first-person yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ارْحَمْهُما﴾: a verb of supplication and its object, and its fāʿil is latent; the vocative clause and ارحمهما are the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition, and mā is maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar). ﴿رَبَّيانِي﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive, and the two are attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its implied form being "ارحمهما رحمة مثل" etc. ﴿صَغِيراً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِما﴾: mā is a relative noun, and the two are attached to أعلم. ﴿فِي نُفُوسِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿تَكُونُوا﴾: an imperfect incomplete (nāqiṣ) verb, jussive (majzūm), and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿صالِحِينَ﴾: khabar, accusative by the yāʾ. ﴿فَإِنَّهُ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and inna and its noun; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis). ﴿كانَ لِلْأَوَّابِينَ غَفُوراً﴾: kāna, and its noun is omitted, and غفورا is its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to غفورا, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَآتِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and آت is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿ذَا﴾: first mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the alif because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿الْقُرْبى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَقَّهُ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْمِسْكِينَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ذا. ﴿وَابْنَ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿السَّبِيلِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيراً﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive, and its mafʿūl muṭlaq, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:27-29.t: ﴿إِنَّ الْمُبَذِّرِينَ﴾: inna and its noun, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause gives the reason for the prohibition and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿إِخْوانَ﴾: khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿الشَّياطِينِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَكانَ الشَّيْطانُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and kāna and its noun. ﴿لِرَبِّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to كفور, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَفُوراً﴾: khabar, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِمَّا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, in is conditional, and mā is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿تُعْرِضَنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), and it is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis). ﴿عَنْهُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb. ﴿ابْتِغاءَ﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿رَحْمَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رحمة. ﴿تَرْجُوها﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw because of heaviness; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَقُلْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قل. ﴿قَوْلًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مَيْسُوراً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis). ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَجْعَلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive lā, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿يَدَكَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَغْلُولَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلى عُنُقِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مغلولة. ﴿وَلا تَبْسُطْها﴾: conjoined to ولا تجعل, and its i'rab is like it; its fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كُلَّ﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative, and ﴿الْبَسْطِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَتَقْعُدَ﴾: the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after it, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَلُوماً مَحْسُوراً﴾: two ḥāls.

daas-irab:30-32.t: ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the kāf is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَبْسُطُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is omitted [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the book calls it latent (mustatir)], and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿الرِّزْقَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لِمَنْ﴾: من is a relative noun, and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to يبسط. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَيَقْدِرُ﴾: conjoined to يشاء [Translator's note: so in the source; in meaning it is conjoined to يبسط], and its i'rab is like it. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is omitted. ﴿بِعِبادِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خبيرا. ﴿خَبِيراً بَصِيراً﴾: two khabars of kāna. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَقْتُلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَوْلادَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَشْيَةَ﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿إِمْلاقٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿نَرْزُقُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَإِيَّاكُمْ﴾: an accusative pronoun conjoined to the object of نرزقهم. ﴿إِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ﴾: inna and its noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ خِطْأً﴾: kāna, and its noun is omitted, and خطئا is the khabar. ﴿كَبِيراً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَقْرَبُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿الزِّنى﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete past verb, and its noun is omitted. ﴿فاحِشَةً﴾: the khabar of kāna. ﴿وَساءَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ساء is a past verb for expressing blame, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿سَبِيلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification).

daas-irab:33-35.t: ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَقْتُلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿النَّفْسَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun, an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to تقتلوا. ﴿وَمَنْ قُتِلَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); and a passive past verb, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَظْلُوماً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَقَدْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لِوَلِيِّهِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun occupy the place of the second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سُلْطاناً﴾: first mafʿūl bihi of جعلنا, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis). ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿يُسْرِفْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْقَتْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يسرف. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent. ﴿مَنْصُوراً﴾: its khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَلا تَقْرَبُوا مالَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, lā is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and ﴿مالَ﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْيَتِيمِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿بِالَّتِي﴾: a relative noun, genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and the two are attached to تقربوا. ﴿هِيَ أَحْسَنُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿يَبْلُغَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after حتى; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive, and the two are attached to تقربوا. ﴿أَشُدَّهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَوْفُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِالْعَهْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوفوا. ﴿إِنَّ الْعَهْدَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ مَسْؤُلًا﴾: inna [Translator's note: so in the source; read "kāna"] and its khabar, and its noun is omitted; the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَأَوْفُوا﴾: conjoined to أوفوا, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿الْكَيْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿كِلْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَزِنُوا﴾: conjoined to what preceded; it is an imperative verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِالْقِسْطاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to زنوا. ﴿الْمُسْتَقِيمِ﴾: an adjective. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address; it is mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: khabar, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَحْسَنُ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to خير. ﴿تَأْوِيلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification).

daas-irab:36-38.t: ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَقْفُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the weak letter, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَيْسَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عِلْمٌ﴾: the noun of laysa, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ السَّمْعَ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤادَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes, and the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿كُلُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the kāf is for address; the clause كل etc. is the khabar of inna. ﴿كانَ عَنْهُ مَسْؤُلًا﴾: kāna and its khabar, and its noun is omitted; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar, and the clause is the khabar of كل. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَمْشِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by lā through the deletion of the weak letter, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تمش. ﴿مَرَحاً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَنْ﴾: a particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿تَخْرِقَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by lan, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَلَنْ تَبْلُغَ الْجِبالَ﴾: conjoined to the preceding one, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿طُولًا﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿كُلُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿كانَ سَيِّئُهُ﴾: kāna and its noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the khabar, and the clause is the khabar of كل. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿مَكْرُوهاً﴾: the khabar of kāna.

daas-irab:39-41.t: ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: mā is a relative noun; the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَوْحى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوحى. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾: fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنَ الْحِكْمَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوحى or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلا تَجْعَلْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, lā is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and its fāʿil is omitted; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَعَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to تجعل. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلهاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آخَرَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَتُلْقى﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted. ﴿فِي جَهَنَّمَ﴾: جهنم is a diptote, genitive (majrūr), its sign of the genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra; the two are attached to تلقى. ﴿مَلُوماً مَدْحُوراً﴾: two ḥāls. ﴿أَفَأَصْفاكُمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb and its fronted object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾: a postponed fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالْبَنِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أصفاكم; it is genitive by the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿وَاتَّخَذَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اتخذ. ﴿إِناثاً﴾: first mafʿūl bihi; as for its second object, it is من الملائكة. ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَتَقُولُونَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿قَوْلًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿عَظِيماً﴾: an adjective. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿صَرَّفْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath. ﴿فِي هذَا﴾: the hā is for drawing attention, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive; the two are attached to صرفنا. ﴿الْقُرْآنِ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿لِيَذَّكَّرُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an, through the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the lām and what follows it are attached to صرفنا. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is of the ḥāl, and mā is negative. ﴿يَزِيدُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is omitted, and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿نُفُوراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:42-44.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾: an adverb of place attached (mutaʿalliq) to the fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿آلِهَةٌ﴾: the noun of kāna, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition, and mā is maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar). ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the kāf and what follows it are attached to the omitted khabar of kāna. ﴿إِذاً﴾: a particle of answer and requital. ﴿لَابْتَغَوْا﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of law, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif deleted because of the meeting of two quiescents, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِلى ذِي﴾: ذي is genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns, and the two are attached to ابتغوا. ﴿الْعَرْشِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سَبِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿سُبْحانَهُ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; it is a resumptive clause. ﴿وَتَعالى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿تَعالى﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَمَّا﴾: mā is a relative noun, and the two are attached to تعالى. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عُلُوًّا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿كَبِيراً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿تُسَبِّحُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تسبح. ﴿السَّماواتُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿وَالْأَرْضُ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: a relative noun conjoined to what preceded, and it is in the position of the nominative. ﴿فِيهِنَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and in is negative. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive in form and nominative in position; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿يُسَبِّحُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِحَمْدِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يسبح, and the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿تَفْقَهُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَسْبِيحَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ حَلِيماً غَفُوراً﴾: kāna and its two khabars, and its noun is omitted; the clause is the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:45-46.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿قَرَأْتَ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْقُرْآنَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of إذا. ﴿بَيْنَكَ﴾: an adverb of place attached (mutaʿalliq) to جعلنا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَبَيْنَ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the book calls such a clause the ṣila (relative clause)]. ﴿بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤمنون. ﴿حِجاباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مَسْتُوراً﴾: an adjective. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جعلنا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَكِنَّةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَفْقَهُوهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, its sign of the accusative being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "خشية أن" etc. ﴿وَفِي آذانِهِمْ وَقْراً﴾: conjoined to قلوبهم. ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿ذَكَرْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبَّكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الْقُرْآنِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ذكرت. ﴿وَحْدَهُ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلَّوْا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif deleted because of the meeting of two quiescents, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿عَلى أَدْبارِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ولوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نُفُوراً﴾: ḥāl or its mafʿūl li-ajlihi.

daas-irab:47-49.t: ﴿نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِما﴾: mā is a relative noun, and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أعلم. ﴿يَسْتَمِعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يستمعون. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time attached to أعلم. ﴿يَسْتَمِعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يستمعون. ﴿وَإِذْ هُمْ نَجْوى﴾: إذ is an adverb conjoined to what precedes it, and mubtadaʾ and khabar, nominative by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb, badal (substitute) of the إذ before it. ﴿يَقُولُ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a particle of negation. ﴿تَتَّبِعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿رَجُلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مَسْحُوراً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿انْظُرْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ضَرَبُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ضربوا. ﴿الْأَمْثالَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَضَلُّوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فَلا﴾: lā is negative. ﴿يَسْتَطِيعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿سَبِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَإِذا﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿كُنَّا عِظاماً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿وَرُفاتاً﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and inna, and نا is its noun, and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the khabar is nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿خَلْقاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) or ḥāl. ﴿جَدِيداً﴾: an adjective, and the clause is emphatic (muʾakkida).

daas-irab:50-51.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿كُونُوا﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperative verb, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿حِجارَةً﴾: the khabar (predicate) of كانوا [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb is كونوا], and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَوْ حَدِيداً﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to حجارة. ﴿أَوْ خَلْقاً﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: mā is a relative noun, and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted adjective of خلقا. ﴿يَكْبُرُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي صُدُورِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يكبر, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَسَيَقُولُونَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿مَنْ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُعِيدُنا﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and نا is its object, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and its khabar is omitted; the clause is the speech reported. ﴿فَطَرَكُمْ﴾: a past verb and its object, its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَسَيُنْغِضُونَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينغضون. ﴿رُؤُسَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَتى﴾: an interrogative noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿هُوَ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the speech reported. ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَسى﴾: a past verb of hope (tarajjī), and its noun is omitted. ﴿أَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَكُونَ﴾: an imperfect incomplete verb whose noun is latent. ﴿قَرِيباً﴾: khabar; the clause عسى etc. is the speech reported, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is the khabar of عسى.

daas-irab:52-54.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time in the position of the accusative as an adverbial, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). ﴿يَدْعُوكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw because of heaviness, and the kāf is its object, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِحَمْدِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "حامدين" (praising). ﴿وَتَظُنُّونَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنْ﴾: negative. ﴿لَبِثْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تظنون. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَقُلْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and قل is an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِعِبادِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قل, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَقُولُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command, its sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿هِيَ أَحْسَنُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ الشَّيْطانَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿يَنْزَغُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: attached to ينزغ. ﴿إِنَّ الشَّيْطانَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause is a badal (substitute) of the first إن الشيطان. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is omitted. ﴿لِلْإِنْسانِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عدوا. ﴿عَدُوًّا﴾: the khabar of kāna. ﴿مُبِيناً﴾: an adjective, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعلم. ﴿إِنْ يَشَأْ﴾: in is conditional, and an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿يَرْحَمْكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis), and its fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is its object; the clause has no grammatical position because it is an apodosis not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿أَوْ إِنْ يَشَأْ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ﴾: conjoined to the preceding one. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negative. ﴿أَرْسَلْناكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to وكيلا. ﴿وَكِيلًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; أرسل does not normally take a second object, and وكيلا is usually parsed as a ḥāl].

daas-irab:55-56.t: ﴿وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِمَنْ﴾: من is a relative noun, genitive (majrūr), and the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أعلم. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿فَضَّلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بَعْضَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿النَّبِيِّينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to فضلنا, and the clause is the answer to an oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَآتَيْنا داوُدَ زَبُوراً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ادْعُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿زَعَمْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of an implied "آلهة" (gods), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and lā is negative. ﴿يَمْلِكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَشْفَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الضُّرِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كشف. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is negative. ﴿تَحْوِيلًا﴾: conjoined to كشف.

daas-irab:57-59.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: أولاء is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is for address. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, badal (substitute), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يَبْتَغُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿إِلى رَبِّهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to يبتغون. ﴿الْوَسِيلَةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَيُّهُمْ﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَقْرَبُ﴾: khabar, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of يدعون. ﴿وَيَرْجُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿رَحْمَتَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَخافُونَ عَذابَهُ﴾: conjoined to what preceded, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿إِنَّ عَذابَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كانَ مَحْذُوراً﴾: kāna and its khabar, and its noun is omitted; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and in is negative, without governing effect. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قَرْيَةٍ﴾: mubtadaʾ, genitive in form and nominative in position; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُهْلِكُوها﴾: khabar, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural, the nūn having been deleted because of the iḍāfa, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar of قرية. ﴿قَبْلَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to مهلكوها. ﴿يَوْمِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ مُعَذِّبُوها﴾: conjoined to مهلكوها. ﴿عَذاباً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿شَدِيداً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿كانَ ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as the noun of kāna, the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿فِي الْكِتابِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مسطورا. ﴿مَسْطُوراً﴾: the khabar of kāna, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negative. ﴿مَنَعَنا﴾: a past verb and its first object, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ نُرْسِلَ﴾: an puts the verb in the accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an; it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), the second object of منع. ﴿بِالْآياتِ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant, and الآيات is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿أَنْ﴾: lightened (mukhaffafa) from anna; its noun is omitted, being the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); it and what follows it are in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of منعنا. ﴿كَذَّبَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿بِهَا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كذب. ﴿الْأَوَّلُونَ﴾: fāʿil, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَآتَيْنا ثَمُودَ النَّاقَةَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿مُبْصِرَةً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَظَلَمُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِهَا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ظلموا. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negative. ﴿نُرْسِلَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِالْآياتِ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant, and الآيات is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿تَخْوِيفاً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).

daas-irab:60-61.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذ is an adverb attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). ﴿قُلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قلنا. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَحاطَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿بِالنَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أحاط. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negative. ﴿جَعَلْنَا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الرُّؤْيَا﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿أَرَيْناكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿فِتْنَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالشَّجَرَةَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الرؤيا. ﴿الْمَلْعُونَةَ﴾: an adjective of الشجرة, and it is the tree of al-Zaqqūm. ﴿فِي الْقُرْآنِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to الملعونة. ﴿وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and mā is negative. ﴿يَزِيدُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its first object, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿طُغْياناً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَبِيراً﴾: an adjective. ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذ is an adverb attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر". ﴿قُلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِلْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قلنا. ﴿اسْجُدُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the speech reported. ﴿لِآدَمَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اسجدوا. ﴿فَسَجَدُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿إِبْلِيسَ﴾: excepted by إلا, accusative. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَأَسْجُدُ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the speech reported. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾: من is a relative noun, and the two are attached to أسجد. ﴿خَلَقْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿طِيناً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), or tamyīz (specification), or accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "من طين" (from clay).

daas-irab:62-64.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَرَأَيْتَكَ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object; the meaning of أرأيتك is "أخبرني" (tell me); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿هذَا﴾: the hā is for drawing attention, and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun; it, together with its ṣila (relative clause), is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿كَرَّمْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to كرمت. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; in is a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive. ﴿أَخَّرْتَنِ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil, and it is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the first-person yāʾ is omitted; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخرتن. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and أحتنكنّ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is omitted; the nūn of emphasis has no grammatical position. ﴿ذُرِّيَّتَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause, like the preceding one, has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an omitted oath. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: excepted by إلا. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is omitted, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿اذْهَبْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the speech reported. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, a mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَبِعَكَ﴾: a past verb and its object, and its fāʿil is latent; it is in the position of the jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; inna is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ جَزاؤُكُمْ﴾: the noun of inna and its khabar, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of من. ﴿جَزاءً﴾: ḥāl, or tamyīz (specification), or mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مَوْفُوراً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause of the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis) is in the position of the jussive. ﴿وَاسْتَفْزِزْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَنِ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اسْتَطَعْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿بِصَوْتِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to استفزز. ﴿وَأَجْلِبْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أجلب. ﴿بِخَيْلِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أجلب. ﴿وَرَجِلِكَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَشارِكْهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its object, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْأَمْوالِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شاركهم. ﴿وَالْأَوْلادِ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿وَعِدْهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its object, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is the wāw of the ḥāl, and mā is negative. ﴿يَعِدُهُمُ الشَّيْطانُ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿غُرُوراً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) or ḥāl, and the clause is parenthetical and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:65-68.t: ﴿إِنَّ عِبادِي﴾: inna and its noun, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, its appearance being prevented by the place being occupied by the vowel suited to the yāʾ; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَيْسَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to the fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿سُلْطانٌ﴾: the noun of laysa, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَكَفى﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and كفى is a past verb. ﴿بِرَبِّكَ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and ربك is the fāʿil (agent), genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿وَكِيلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبُّكُمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُزْجِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يزجي. ﴿الْفُلْكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) and has no grammatical position. ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يزجي. ﴿لِتَبْتَغُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of cause, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the lām and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to يزجي. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تبتغوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause gives the reason and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيماً﴾: kāna, and its noun is omitted, and رحيما is its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to رحيما, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ﴾: a past verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مسكم. ﴿ضَلَّ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil, and the clause is the apodosis of إذا. ﴿تَدْعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿إِيَّاهُ﴾: an accusative pronoun in the position of the accusative as excepted. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لمّا, the temporal one ("when"), is an adverb of time. ﴿نَجَّاكُمْ﴾: a past verb and its object, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَى الْبَرِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نجاكم. ﴿أَعْرَضْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of لما. ﴿وَكانَ الْإِنْسانُ كَفُوراً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَفَأَمِنْتُمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَخْسِفَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يخسف. ﴿جانِبَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْبَرِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ يُرْسِلَ﴾: conjoined to يخسف. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يرسل. ﴿حاصِباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لا تَجِدُوا﴾: lā is negative, and an imperfect verb conjoined to what precedes it; it is accusative like it, by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجدوا. ﴿وَكِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:69-70.t: ﴿أَمْ أَمِنْتُمْ﴾: أم is a conjunction, and أمنتم is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يُعِيدَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the kāf is its object, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to يعيدكم. ﴿تارَةً﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿أُخْرى﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَيُرْسِلَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يرسل. ﴿قاصِفاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الرِّيحِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قاصفا. ﴿فَيُغْرِقَكُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb conjoined to what precedes it, accusative like it, and the kāf is its object, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِما﴾: mā is a relative noun;
